title: Standard hook — 180° bend
statement: (a) A standard hook may have a 180° bend plus an extension of at least 4 bar diameters, but not less than 65 mm, at the free end of the bar.
scope_note: Covers clause (a) only: the 180° standard hook. The 90° hook is 8.1.2.1.B and stirrup/tie hooks are 8.1.2.1.C.
